type.quote: The board shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, three members appointed by the Governor who shall be persons representing the public at large and nine members appointed by the Governor, five of whom shall be registered professional engineers, two of whom shall be registered professional land surveyors and two of whom shall be registered professional geologists.

exams.notes: Must be passed to become certified as an engineer intern before proceeding to the principles and practice examination.
exams.quote: An applicant for licensure as a professional engineer shall satisfactorily complete the engineering fundamentals examination and become certified as an engineer intern

exams.name: Engineering Principles and Practice Examination (PE)
exams.notes: Requires engineer intern certificate plus four or more years of qualifying experience.
exams.quote: An applicant who is a certified engineer intern may apply for licensure and shall pass the examination in engineering principles and practice.

available.quote: Holds an unexpired license or certificate of registration issued to him by proper authority of some other state, foreign country or territory of the United States in which the requirements and qualifications to engage in the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology were at the time of the initial issuance of such license or certificate of registration at least equal to the existing standards of this Commonwealth ... A person may be licensed under this subsection without examination.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an unexpired license from another state, territory, or foreign country where requirements were at least equal to Pennsylvania standards, and that jurisdiction must similarly license Pennsylvania professionals. Alternatively, holders of a National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES) certificate of qualifications may be licensed without examination.
requirements.quote: the board may in its discretion enter into agreements for reciprocity with the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying and with states under such rules and regulations as the board may prescribe.

scope_protection.quote: the performance of the foregoing acts and services being prohibited to persons who are not licensed under this act as professional engineers unless exempt under other provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining license, certification or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: of the practice of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining his license, certification or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: of gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of engineering, in the practice of land surveying or in the practice of geology

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the code of ethics of the engineering profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or of violation of the code of ethics of the engineering profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for criminal offenses such as extortion, bribery or fraud relating to the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction for a criminal offense such as extortion, bribery or fraud or entry of a plea of nolo contendere to a charge thereof for conduct relating to the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this act or any regulation promulgated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or has violated any provision of this act or any regulation promulgated by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting other than as a faithful agent or trustee, or accepting remuneration beyond stated recompense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To act for the person's client or employer in professional matters otherwise than as a faithful agent or trustee, or to accept any remuneration other than the person's stated recompense for services rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to falsely or maliciously injure the professional reputation, prospects or business of anyone.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to injure falsely or maliciously, directly or indirectly, the professional reputation, prospects or business of anyone.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to supplant another engineer, land surveyor or geologist after definite steps toward their employment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to supplant another engineer, land surveyor or geologist after definite steps have been taken toward the other's employment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Competing with another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for employment using unethical practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To compete with another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for employment by the use of unethical practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Reviewing the work of another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for the same client without their knowledge, unless their connection with the work has terminated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To review the work of another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for the same client, except with the knowledge of that engineer, land surveyor or geologist, or unless the connection of that engineer, land surveyor or geologist with the work has terminated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or render technical services without fair and just compensation commensurate with services rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to obtain or render technical services or assistance without fair and just compensation commensurate with the services rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in self-laudatory language or in any manner derogatory to the dignity of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To advertise in self-laudatory language, or in any other manner, derogatory to the dignity of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to practice in any field of engineering, land surveying or geology in which the registrant is not proficient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to practice in any field of engineering, land surveying or geology in which the registrant is not proficient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or permitting use of professional seal on work over which the person was not in responsible charge.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To use or permit the use of the person's professional seal on work over which the person was not in responsible charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology not in accordance with the provisions of this act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To aid or abet any person in the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology not in accordance with the provision of this act or prior laws.

definition_quote.value: the application of the mathematical and physical sciences for the design or analysis of public or private buildings, structures, machines, equipment, processes, works or engineering systems, and the consultation, investigation, evaluation or surveys, construction management, modification and alteration, planning and inspection in connection therewith
definition_quote.quote: the application of the mathematical and physical sciences for the design or analysis of public or private buildings, structures, machines, equipment, processes, works or engineering systems, and the consultation, investigation, evaluation or surveys, construction management, modification and alteration, planning and inspection in connection therewith

approximate.matched_normalized: for any person to practice or to offer to practice land surveying unless he is licensed and registered under the laws of this commonwealth as a professional land surveyor

covers_geology.quote: for any person to practice or to offer to practice geology unless he is licensed and registered under the laws of this Commonwealth as a professional geologist.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer Intern" means a candidate for licensure as a professional engineer, who has been granted a certificate as an engineer intern after successfully passing the prescribed written examination in fundamental engineering subjects

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "Surveyor-in-Training" means a candidate for licensure as a professional land surveyor who has been granted a certificate as a surveyor-in-training after successfully passing the prescribed written examination in fundamental land surveying subjects

geologist_in_training_certificate_availa.quote: "Geologist-in-training" means a candidate for licensure as a professional geologist who has been granted a certificate as a geologist-in-training after successfully passing the required written examination in fundamental geology subjects

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: The board may grant one year of experience credit for each postbaccalaureate engineering degree earned by applicants for licensure, not to exceed two years

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible Charge" means a position that requires initiative, skill and independent judgment, and implies such degree of competence and accountability gained by technical education and experience of a grade and character as is sufficient to qualify an individual to personally and independently engage in and be entrusted with the work involved in the practice of engineering or land surveying.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Such seal, or a facsimile imprint of same, shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plats and reports issued by a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist.

seal_document_types.quote: shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plats and reports issued by a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: it shall be unlawful for any firm or corporation to engage in such practice, or to offer to practice ... unless the directing heads and employes of such firm or corporation in responsible charge of its activities in the practice of such profession are licensed and registered in conformity with the requirements of this act

value: Practice under supervision of a licensed professional engineer without assuming responsible charge
Nonresident practice not exceeding 30 days per calendar year if legally qualified in their home state
Officers and employees of the U.S. Government practicing for the government
Regular employees of public utility companies for regulated facilities (if the utility employs at least one licensed PE in responsible charge)
Duly registered architects doing engineering work incidental to architectural work
Practice on property owned by the practitioner or their employer unless it affects public safety or property of others
Manufacturing, mining, communications, R&D or industrial corporations for work incidental to their products or non-engineering services
Running of lines, grades, and layout work on established property limits by contractors or home builders in construction
Preparation of shop drawings or construction management services by persons customarily engaged in construction
Individuals providing geologic services to businesses engaged in gas or oil exploration or development
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Except as specifically provided in this section, this act shall not be construed to require licensure and registration in the following cases

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: the code of ethics is as follows: It shall be considered unprofessional and inconsistent with honorable and dignified bearing for a person who is a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist

multi_license_reporting_required.quote: Any licensee of this Commonwealth who is also licensed to practice engineering, land surveying or geology in any other state, territory or country shall report this information to the board on the biennial renewal application.

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: the professional members of the board shall be so selected that not more than two of them shall specialize in any one of the five major disciplines of engineering: civil, mining and metallurgical, mechanical, electrical and chemical.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each professional member shall have been engaged in the practice of the respective profession for at least ten years and shall have been in responsible charge of work for at least five years.

pdh_units_per_renewal_period.quote: Each licensee shall be required to obtain twenty-four PDH units during the biennial renewal period.

pdh_carryover_max_units.quote: If a licensee exceeds the requirement in any renewal period, a maximum of twelve PDH units may be carried forward into the subsequent renewal period.

retired_status_license_available.quote: A licensee who lists his occupation as retired on the board-approved renewal form and certifies to the board that he no longer engages in the practice of his licensed profession shall be exempt from the requirement set forth in subsection (a), and the board shall issue him a retired-status license.
